sources.title: Inventory of the North Carolina Forest Service Photograph Collection, 1913-1947

notes_for_editor: Height correction: the record's 30.2 m does not match the source's 99 ft 9 in, which is about 30.4 m. The 1944 build date and the height rest on one page that quotes the state's 10th Biennial Report; no second source for this tower was found after two WebSearch queries. Removal date unknown. The 1926 and CCC sentences are statewide context from the NC Forest Service photograph collection abstract and do not describe Ansonville itself. A Facebook group post about three Anson County towers came up in search but returned only its title when fetched, so it is not used. The agency name is not settled: the same statewide list credits other Anson County towers to both the Forest Service and the Division of Forest Resources, so the story names only the Forest Service as the page does. Fact-check 2026-10-10: tnlandforms.us is a third-party list, so the story now calls it a statewide list rather than the state's list; its Tom Dunigan byline is not on the page and is dropped from the source.
